008package paint.fiji.tracks;
009
010import fiji.plugin.trackmate.Spot;
011import fiji.plugin.trackmate.TrackModel;
012
013import java.util.ArrayList;
014import java.util.Comparator;
015import java.util.List;
016
017import static paint.shared.utils.Miscellaneous.round;
018
019/**
020 * Provides static methods to compute motion-related attributes for a given
021 * TrackMate track, including total distance, diffusion coefficients,
022 * confinement ratio, and displacement.
023 * <p>
024 * Designed as a utility class — not instantiable.
025 * </p>
026 */
027public final class TrackAttributeCalculations {
028
029    /**
030     * Private constructor to prevent instantiation.
031     */
032    private TrackAttributeCalculations() {
033        // Utility class; prevent instantiation
034    }
035
036    /**
037     * Computes motion and diffusion-related attributes for a single track.
038     * <p>
039     * Calculated attributes include:
040     * <ul>
041     *   <li>Number of spots in track</li>
042     *   <li>Total travel distance</li>
043     *   <li>Diffusion coefficients (standard and extended)</li>
044     *   <li>Confinement ratio</li>
045     *   <li>Net displacement</li>
046     * </ul>
047     *
048     * @param trackModel the {@link TrackModel} containing track and spot data
049     * @param trackId    the unique identifier of the track to analyze
050     * @param dtSeconds  the time interval between consecutive frames, in seconds
051     * @return a {@link TrackAttributes} object containing all computed metrics
052     */
053    public static TrackAttributes calculateTrackAttributes(TrackModel trackModel, int trackId, double dtSeconds) {
054
055        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
056        // Step 1 – Collect and sort track spots
057        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
058        final List<Spot> spots = new ArrayList<>(trackModel.trackSpots(trackId));
059        if (spots.size() < 2) {
060            return new TrackAttributes();
061        }
062        spots.sort(Comparator.comparingInt(s -> (int) Math.round(s.getFeature(Spot.FRAME))));
063
064        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
065        // Step 2 – Initialize variables
066        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
067        double totalDistance       = 0.0;
068        double cumMsd              = 0.0;
069        double cumMsdExt           = 0.0;
070        double diffusionCoeff      = Double.NaN;
071        double diffusionCoeffExt   = Double.NaN;
072        double confinementRatio    = Double.NaN;
073        int    numberSpotsInTrack  = spots.size();
074
075        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
076        // Step 3 – Reference coordinates
077        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
078        final double x0     = get(spots.get(0), Spot.POSITION_X);
079        final double y0     = get(spots.get(0), Spot.POSITION_Y);
080        final double xLast  = get(spots.get(spots.size() - 1), Spot.POSITION_X);
081        final double yLast  = get(spots.get(spots.size() - 1), Spot.POSITION_Y);
082
083        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
084        // Step 4 – Compute distances and MSD values
085        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
086        for (int i = 1; i < spots.size(); i++) {
087
088            // The previous point
089            final double x1 = get(spots.get(i - 1), Spot.POSITION_X);
090            final double y1 = get(spots.get(i - 1), Spot.POSITION_Y);
091
092            // The current point
093            final double x2 = get(spots.get(i), Spot.POSITION_X);
094            final double y2 = get(spots.get(i), Spot.POSITION_Y);
095
096            // For MSD Ext, take the distance to the previous point
097            final double dx = x2 - x1;
098            final double dy = y2 - y1;
099
100            // For MSD, take the distance to the first point
101            final double dx0   = x2 - x0;
102            final double dy0   = y2 - y0;
103
104            // Calculate the cumulative values
105            cumMsd            += dx0 * dx0 + dy0 * dy0;
106            cumMsdExt         += dx * dx + dy * dy;
107
108            // Also calculate the increase in total distance
109            totalDistance += Math.hypot(dx, dy);
110        }
111
112        // Diffusion coefficients (remain NaN if insufficient data or dtSeconds <= 0)
113        final int nSteps = spots.size() - 1;
114
115        if (nSteps > 0 && dtSeconds > 0.0) {
116            final double msd = cumMsd / nSteps;
117            final double msdExt = cumMsdExt / nSteps;
118
119            diffusionCoeff    = round(msd / (4.0 * dtSeconds), 2);
120            diffusionCoeffExt = round(msdExt / (4.0 * dtSeconds), 2);
121        }
122
123        // Calculate the displacement between the first and last spot
124        double displacement = Math.hypot(xLast - x0, yLast - y0);
125
126        // Calculate the Confinement ratio = displacement / total distance
127        if (totalDistance > 0.0) {
128            confinementRatio = round(displacement / totalDistance, 2);
129        }
130
131        // If totalDistance is zero, keep it as NaN for downstream consistency
132        if (totalDistance == 0.0) {
133            totalDistance = Double.NaN;
134        }
135
136        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
137        // Step 6 – Return immutable result
138        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
139        return new TrackAttributes(
140                numberSpotsInTrack,
141                totalDistance,
142                diffusionCoeff,
143                diffusionCoeffExt,
144                confinementRatio
145        );
146    }
147
148    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
149    // Helper methods
150    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
151
152    /**
153     * Retrieves a numerical feature value from a {@link Spot}.
154     * Returns 0.0 if the feature is missing or {@code null}.
155     *
156     * @param s          the spot to read from
157     * @param featureKey the feature name (e.g. {@code Spot.POSITION_X})
158     * @return the feature value or 0.0 if unavailable
159     */
160    private static double get(Spot s, String featureKey) {
161        final Double v = s.getFeature(featureKey);
162        return v == null ? 0.0 : v;
163    }
164}
